text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the butter's melting. Um, what 
was next again?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Now I'll add the carrot 
powder...!
choice_data_list: Then I'll get the die-cut candy ready...

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer was helping her junior 
Umamusume make sweets. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, n-no way!? Palmer-senpai!? W-What are 
you doing here...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the cafeteria with Trainer, 
I heard someone sounding troubled~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm, well... I was trying to make some 
refreshments...

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-We've never made cookies before! They 
got burned, everything was chaotic... I'm 
so sorry for making such a fuss!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, don't worry about that! Come on, 
let me help out a bit too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Watching made me want to give it a try 
too!

And so, we started cooking together, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the dough looks about right. 
Let's roll it out!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is... whoa, it's so salty! 
Aaah, I totally messed up... I mixed up 
the sugar and salt in the batter...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's your first time with the 
recipe after all! Though as a treat to 
share, it's totally fine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make some salty cookies for sodium 
replenishment, and pair them with the 
sweet ones I'm kneading so everyone can 
enjoy the combo!"

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Palmer-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, got it. You can move now! Hehe, to 
get flour on your nose and not even 
notice—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're so hardworking and cute! Watching 
you makes me want to do everything for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A-A-Anything...!? Hawawawa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, all done, all done! Come on, 
open wide. Say aaah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Doesn't the test batch 
look like it's turning out great?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! It's, so, DELICIOUS!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, your face is red? Ah, was it still 
too hot!? Sorry!
choice_data_list:
(How can she say that without even 
realizing it...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All done! Whoa, no way! It baked to 
absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to summon your courage 
and hand it over! I really hope they love 
your gift~!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Courage... ...U-Um, Palmer-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Please take these cookies...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, what!? Me!?

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, the truth is... These cookies were 
what I was trying to bake to give to 
Palmer-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even though we made it together, giving it 
to you as a present feels a bit strange, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I had so much fun making it. If 
anything, getting to experience that was a 
reward in itself! So this is kind of my 
way of saying thanks...!”
choice_data_list: So they were Palmer's fans, huh.
So they were Palmer's fans, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's that... That's just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is totally the best! Wah, thank you 
so much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I saw them making it, I can really 
feel both of their feelings coming 
through, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Along with the cookies, I feel like I got 
some wonderful memories too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll gladly feast upon your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... it's... so painful... 
Palmer-senpai's fan service was incredible 
to the very end...
choice_data_list: Being a fan takes stamina too, huh.
Being a fan takes stamina too, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... it's... so painful... 
Palmer-senpai's fan service was incredible 
to the very end...
choice_data_list: Being a fan takes stamina too, huh.
Being a fan takes stamina too, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Stamina?? Oh, you mean you got tired 
from cooking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You really are sweating. I'll wipe it off 
for you, so look this way!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah...! No, I'm okay! I can do it, I 
can do it myself...!

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoaaahaaaa............!

Rumor had it that Mejiro Palmer's killer 
fan service had left the fans at the 
academy more captivated than ever...

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
R-Right!? I can't believe you understand 
too, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The fact that they're kind without even 
realizing it is just wonderful! Of course 
their races are cool too, which makes me 
want to cheer for them even more...!
choice_data_list: I'll put my all into supporting you too!
I'll put my heart into supporting you too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, whoa, everyone's getting so hyped 
up...!? Uh... th-thank you, everyone...!

Rumor had it that Mejiro Palmer's killer 
fan service had left the fans at the 
academy more captivated than ever...
